s: Tiltul delet vechallon vehammanul beshabbat ubo k"h seipim: peqaq hachallon, kegon luach o shear kol dabar shessotemin bo hachallon, apillu hu dabar sheen alayv torat keli kelal, vegam lo paqaq bo meolam bechol, uba lipqoq bo battechilla beshabbat — im chashab alayv mibbeod yom lipqoq bo (beshabbat, o shechashab alayv sheyyihyeh mukan veomed lihyot peqaq lachallon, ap al pi shello chashab al hashshabbat beperush) — hare zeh muttar, sheal yede machashaba zo yorda alayv torat keli vehuttar betiltul kishar kol hakkelim (kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"ch shemmachashaba moelet bedabar sheddarko leyachado lekak. Veim paqaq bo paam achat mibbeod yom, ap shello chashab alayv lipqoq bo beshabbat, yorda alayv torat keli al yede peqiqa zo, kevan shehu dabar sheddarko leyachado lekak, kemo shennitbaer sham). Vaapillu arubba shebbaggag muttar lipqoq bappeqaq hammuttar betiltul, ap al pi sheeno qashur vetaluy sham mibbeod yom. Veen bazeh mishshum asiyyat ohel beshabbat, mippene sheeno oseh bazeh ella tosapot leohel, vehosapa zo aray hi, sheenah asuya lehitqayyem harbeh, shehi asuya lehippateach tadir, vetosepet ohel aray mutteret, velo aseru ella laasot kol haohel aray, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman sht"v. Lepikak im en peqaq zeh asuy lehippateach tadir ella leittim rechoqim — asur lipqoq, apillu hu challon shebbakkotel, mippene shehu kemosip binyan haqqabua bakkotel:

Veqaneh shehitqino lihyot noel bo, shettochabo bakkotel etzel haddelet — en tzarik sheyyiqsherennu baddelet mibbeod yom, sheap shello haya qashur vetaluy sham mibbeod yom vetochabo sham beshabbat — en bo mishshum boneh beshabbat, hoil veeno mebattelo sham, ella asuy lehotzio ulehakniso tadir. Umikkol maqom, domeh hu qetzat lebinyan yoter mippeqaq hachallon vehaarubba. Ulepikak, ap im chashab alayv mibbeod yom linol bo beshabbat, veap im yichado lekak leolam, veap im kebar naal bo peamim rabbot bechol vehu meyuchad lekak — asur linol bo beshabbat, ella im ken tiqqeno veasa bo maaseh vehekino lekak beinyan shettiqquno mokiach alayv shehu omed lekak (sheaz nikkar haddabar sheeno mebattelo sham, ella asuy lehotzio ulehakniso tadir, shekkak mokiach maaseh tiqquno sheal yede maaseh tiqqun zeh yesh alayv torat keli, veen derek leshaqqea keli bebinyan lebattelo sham leolam). Veaz muttar linol bo ap im adayin lo naal bo meolam mibbeod yom. Vegam muttar letaltelo apillu shello letzorek gupo umeqomo, kedin shear kol hakkelim shemmelaktam lehetter. Abal im hu beinyan sheasur linol bo beshabbat, ap shehu meyuchad linol bo bechol — asur letaltelo ki im letzorek gupo o meqomo, keden keli hamyuchad limleket issur:

Veneger shehu yated shettochabin oto bechor shebbaasquppa linol haddelet, hoil vetochabin oto baasquppa lematta — domeh hu lebinyan yoter miqqaneh shettochabin bakkotel min hatztzad, veen noalim bo, ap shehu meyuchad lekak, veap im tiqqeno veasa bo maaseh hammokiach alayv shehu omed lekak, ella tzarik sheyyihyeh qashur sham mibbeod yom (veaz muttar linol bo ap shello naal bo adayin meolam, veap im lo yichado lekak), shehoil vehu qashur umechubbar sham mibbeod yom — eno nireh keboneh beshabbat:

Ketzad yehe qashur? Im yesh berosho gelustera, dehaynu sherosho ab verauy lebukena liktosh velishchoq bo pilpelin, hoil vehu domeh likli — eno nireh kol kak keboneh, sheen derek leshaqqea keli bebinyan lebattelo sham. Ulepikak en tzarik sheyyehe haqqesher ammitz, ella apillu im qashur bechebel daq, sheeno rauy lihyot nittal bechebel zeh, sheim haya rotzeh littelo mishsham uletaltelo al yede chebel zeh, miyyad haya nipsaq — day bekak, apillu im eno qashur baddelet atzmah ella bibriach haddelet (o bammezuza, sheap sheen haddabar nikkar kol kak sheqqashur sham mibbeod yom bishbil neilat haddelet, hoil veeno qashur baddelet atzmah, vegam hoil veen haqqesher ammitz, ap al pi ken eno nireh keboneh beshabbat, hoil vehu domeh likli). Vaapillu im hachebel hu arok veen hanneger taluy kelal baavir kesheshshometo mehachor shebbammiptan, ella kullo munnach baaretz — en bekak kelum, hoil vehu mechubbar sham mibbeod yom al yede hachebel:

Veim en berosho gelustera, im hu qashur baddelet atzmah, apillu qashur bechebel daq sheeno rauy linnatel bo — day bekak (lepi shennikkar yapeh sheqqashur sham mibbeod yom bishbil neilat haddelet, hoil veqashur baddelet atzmah, ap al pi sheen haqqesher ammitz, veshub eno nireh keboneh beshabbat), vaapillu im kullo munnach baaretz kesheshshometo mehachor. Abal im eno qashur baddelet atzmah ella babberiach (o bammezuza) — tzarik sheyyehe haqqesher ammitz beinyan sheyyehe rauy linnatel bo (shekkeshehu qashur yapeh bechebel chazaq, nikkar haddabar shehu omed linilat delet, ap sheeno qashur baddelet atzmah, veshub eno nireh keboneh beshabbat), vaapillu im kullo munnach baaretz kesheshshometo mehachor shebbaasquppa:

Vekol zeh keshehaasquppa hi geboha veen hachor shellah noqeb ad laaretz, abal im nipchat hachor mittachtayv vehiggia laaretz, beinyan shekkeshemmaknis hanneger bachor noqeb hanneger tachtayv baaretz — hare zeh nireh keboneh, veasur linol bo bekol inyan, ap im yesh berosho gelustera, veqashur baddelet bechebel chazaq. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehanneger noqeb tamid neqeb chadash baaretz, abal im mittechilla asa chalal baqqarqa maqom sherosh hanneger yihyeh niknas lesham, veshub en hanneger mosip neqeb baaretz — eno nireh keboneh, umuttar linol bo al derek shennitbaer:

Neger shettachab bo bet yad beemtziuto, vahare hu domeh lemaqqebet shehu keli — muttar linol bo ap im hu noqeb baaretz, veap sheeno qashur kelal, sheeno nireh keboneh, hoil venikkar bo shehu keli. Veeno domeh leyesh berosho gelustera, sheddomeh gam ken likli, veap al pi ken tzarik lihyot qashur veshello yehe noqeb baaretz, lepi shekkan asa bo maaseh beyadayim bitchibat habbet yad letoko, veal yede kak asao keli, mah sheen ken haggelustera lo asaah hu beyadayim bishbil torat keli. Veken habberiach shettochabin qatzeh haechad banneqeb shebbachoma mitztzad haddelet mikkan veqatzeh hashsheni banneqeb shemmitztzad haddelet mikkan, im yesh bo tabbat beemtzaito sheochazin bah bishat peticha uneila umoshekin bah et habberiach — hare hu bet yad labberiach, umuttar linol bo ap sheeno qashur kelal:

Kol petach sheeno asuy liknisa velitzia tadir ella leittim rechoqim, kegon rechaba sheachore habbattim sheen niknasin veyotzein bah tadir, im asa lepitchah delet sheenah sobebet al tzirah (perush "tzir" hu etz chad habbolet min haddelet lehakniso bachor shebbaeden kede shettehe haddelet chozeret lekan ulekan), ella kesherotzeh linol bah zoqepah al chalal happetach lesotmo bah, ben sheddelet zo asuya miqqerashim, ben shehi machatzelet shel qanim shettelaah uzeqapah sham laddelet, veken pirtza shebbagginna veshebbachatzer sheggedarah baqqotzim vaasaum keen delet, velipamim poteach delet zo veniknas veyotze bepirtza zo leittim rechoqim vechozer venoalah, im yesh tzir bidlatot ellu, o apillu en bahem atta ella shehaya lahen tzir venishbar umeqomo nikkar — muttar linol bahen beshabbat, mippene shebbehekker hatztzir shebbahen nikkarin hen shehen delatot haasuyot lipticha uneila, veeno nireh keboneh. Ella shetztzarik lizzaher im yesh lahen tzir shello yachazor hatztzir lechoro, kemo sheyyitbaer. Abal im en lahen hekker tzir — asur linol bahen beshabbat, shehoil veenan asuyin lehippateach ella leittim rechoqim — hare hen nirin binilatan kebinyan mechitztza qebua, kol sheen bahen hekker shehen delatot:

Vaapillu kesheyyesh lahen tzir, lo hittiru linol bahen ella kesheqqesharan utelaan sham mibbeod yom linol bahen, veaz muttar linol bahen ap im kesheppotechan hen nigrarot baaretz ukeshennoalan magbihan vezoqepan al haasquppa, shekkevan shehen qeshurot umechubbarot sham mibbeod yom — eno nireh keboneh beshabbat. Veim qesharo uqebao sham beinyan sheap kesheppotechan enan nigrarot baaretz, apillu enan gebohin min haaretz ella kimlo nima — muttar linol bahem ap im en lahen hekker tzir, mippene sheeno nireh keboneh binila zo, hoil veap keshehen petuchin hen mechubbarim uqebuin sham heteb sheenan nigrarot baaretz:

Upetach heasuy liknisa velitzia tadir — muttar lenoolo apillu bedelet sheen lah hekker tzir vehi nigreret baaretz kesheppotechah, o apillu shometin otah legamre kesheppotechin otah sheenah qeshura sham kelal, lepi shekkevan sheasuya lehippateach tadir — eno oseh binilatah mechitztza qebua ella aray, veen issur kelal laasot mechitztzat aray beshabbat, ella al derek sheyyitbaer besiman sht"v:

Vekol zeh bedelet sheyyesh lah asquppa hattachtona shezzoqepin otah aleha, sheasquppa mokachat al haddelet shehi asuya linila velo lebinyan. Abal im en lah asquppa, ukeshennoalin bah moridin otah al haaretz, ukesheppotechin shometin otah veoqerin otah, hoil veen lah tzurat happetach — en noalin bah, apillu yesh lah tzir, kol sheenah sobebet al tzirah, vaapillu hi geboha min haaretz, vaapillu hu petach heasuy liknisa vitzia tadir. Veyesh mattirin bepetach heasuy liknisa vitzia tadir. Veyesh lehaqel bedibre soperim:

Veken delet heasuy milluach echad, ukesheppotechin shometin otah veoqerim otah, hoil veenah doma lishar delatot — en noalin bah, apillu yesh lah tzir, kol sheenah sobebet al tzirah, vaapillu hi geboha min haaretz, vaapillu yesh lah asquppa, vaapillu hi petach heasuy liknisa vitzia tadir, mippene shennireh keboneh venoten qeresh bakkotel. Veyesh mattirin bepetach heasuy liknisa vitzia tadir. Veyesh lehaqel bedibre soperim:

Abal delet haasuya miqqerashim harbeh veyesh lah asquppa — muttar linol bah ledibre hakkol bepetach heasuy liknisa vitzia tadir, ap sheshshometin veoqerin otah legamre kesheppotechah, sheenah qeshura sham kelal, veap im en lah hekker tzir, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Vehu haddin bemaqom shennoalin biqrashim harbeh meporadim veyesh chaqiqa lemala ulematta shemmaknisin sham haqqerashim, hoil vehappetach naul bekamma qerashim — chashubim kullam kedelet achat asuya miqqerashim harbeh, umuttar linol bahem ap sheshshometin otah legamre kesheppotechin, veap sheen lahem hekker tzir, ella shehu petach heasuy liknisa vitzia tadir:

Kol daltot hakkelim, kegon shidda teba umigdal sheyyesh lahem delatot mitztziddehem, veyesh lahen shene tzirim, dehaynu shene rashim habboletim min haddelet, echad lemala hanniknas bachor shebbammashqop veechad lematta hanniknas bachor shebbaasquppa, im yatza tzir hattachton kullo mimmeqomo — asur lehachaziro, gezera shemma yitqa, dehaynu sheyyehaddeqo sham bechozeq bemaqqabot vegarzen shello yukal od latzet mishsham, veyitchayyeb mishshum boneh, kemo sheyyitbaer, o mishshum makkeh bappattish, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman shy"d. Abal im yatza miqtzato — dochaqo ad shemmachaziro limqomo, veen chosheshin shemma yitqa, lepi sheen tzarik kol kak lazeh, hoil veen kullo yotze mehachor. Abal im yatza tzir haelyon, apillu miqtzato — asur ledochoqo ulehachaziro limqomo, gezera shemma yitqa, shehaelyon tzarik lehaddeqo bechozeq yoter mehattachton, shehattachton hu mitqayyem meelayv bechoro keshehaelyon hu bimqomo:

Vaapillu delet sheen lah tzir lo lemala velo lematta ella beemtzaah, dehaynu shebbeemtzaah bolet rosh echad ukenegdo yesh chor bimzuzat happetach, vetochabin oto bachor keshennoalin haddelet, ukesheppotechin motziin oto mehachor, shekkan en lachush shemma yitqa, shehare haddelet asuya liptoach velinol tadir — ap al pi ken asur lehachazir tzir zeh lechoro beshabbat, gezera mishshum tzir sheeno beemtza haddelet. Abal beyom tob muttar, mishshum simchat yom tob, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tqy"t:

Vekol zeh lehachazir haddelatot, abal littol haddelatot mehakkelim — muttar bekol inyan, im enan tequin bahen bechozeq, veen bazeh mishshum soter, mippene sheen binyan usetira bekelim. Abal im hen tequin bechozeq — yesh bipriqatan mishshum soter, kemo sheyyitbaer:

Abal delet shel bayit veshel bor vedut, o shel kelim hamchubbarim baqqarqa, kegon lul shel tarnegolim shehu keli umechubbar baqqarqa — asur ben littol ben lehachazir, shekkol dabar hamchubbar baqqarqa yesh bo binyan usetira. Lepikak, mah shennohagim bisuddot gedolot bimot hachamma littol hachallonot al yede nokri — lo yapeh hem osim, shehare bintila zo yesh chiyyub chattat leyisrael, shehu soter al menat libnot, shehare atid lehachaziran achar kak, veim ken kesheomer lenokri — hare zeh shebut gamur, veeno shebut dishbut shehittiruhu bimqom mitztaer, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"z. Ulehaomerim shessoter al menat libnot eno chayyab ella im ken dato shebbinyan haacharon yihyeh yoter tob min harishon, kemo shennitbaer besiman ra"ch — en bintilat hachallonot ella issur middibre soperim, velomar lenokri hu shebut dishbut shehittiruhu bimqom mitztaer. Lepikak, en tzarik limchot behammeqillin, kevan sheyyesh lahem al mi sheyyismeku. Abal kol adam yachmir leatzmo kasbara harishona, shehi iqqar. Vegam tzarik lehazhir larabbim shennikshalim shennotelin rebiiyyot hachallonot (sheqqorin qvvatyr"n) min hachallonot, veenam yodeim sheyyesh bazeh issur gadol:

Vaapillu kelim sheenam mechubbarin laqqarqa, im hem gedolim kol kak shemmachaziqin arbaim sea, dehaynu amma al amma berum shalosh ammot im haddepanot belo obi haraglayim vehallebazbezi — hare hem keohel, veyesh bahen binyan usetira, ulepikak asur littol daltotehem mehem:

Lo ameru sheen binyan usetira bekelim ella bebinyan garua usetirat binyan garua, kegon netilat haddelet mehakkeli vehachzaratah, sheen hachazara binyan gamur, hoil vaadayin hi meporeqet mehakkeli, sheenah tequa sham bechozeq veyakol littelah mimmennu beqal, velaken gam netilatah en zo setirat binyan gamur. Veken kol keli shehu shel peraqim, — im en peraqayv tequin bechozeq — en bipriqatan setira gemura, velo behachzaratan binyan gamur. Abal haoseh keli mittechillato — hare zeh binyan gamur, vechayyab mishshum boneh. Vehashshober keli shalem — hare zo setirat binyan gamur, vechayyab mishshum soter. Veken hattoqea haetz betok haqqardom lihyot lo lebet yad — chayyab mishshum boneh. Veken kol hattoqea etz beetz, ben shettaqa bemasmer ben shettaqa baetz atzmo ad shennitached — hare zeh toledet boneh vechayyab. Vekol hampareq etz taqua — chayyab mishshum soter, kemo hassoter binyan gamur:

Vaapillu bikli shel peraqim, im taqa peraqayv, dehaynu shehiddeqam bechozeq beinyan shetztzarik lazeh gebura veummanut — hare zeh binyan gamur, vechayyab mishshum boneh im asuy lehitqayyem harbeh. Veim eno asuy lehitqayyem harbeh — hare zeh binyan aray veasur middibre soperim, ella im ken eno asuy leqiyyum kelal, kemo sheyyitbaer:

Lepikak, kol keli shel peraqim shennitpareq — aseru chakamim lehachaziro beshabbat, apillu eno mehaddeqo ella meat beinyan shehu rapuy veeno rapuy, gezera shemma yitqa bechozeq. Abal im eno mehaddeqo kelal ella mannicho rapuy legamre — muttar. Vehu sheddarko shel keli lihyot kak rapuy leolam, abal im darko lihyot mehuddaq vetaqua bechozeq, ap sheakshav mannicho rapuy — asur lehachaziro, gezera shemma yitqa. Vekos shel peraqim, yesh omerim sheap sheddarko lihyot mehuddaq qetzat — muttar lehachaziro ulehaddeqo qetzat, veen chosheshim shemma yitqa bechozeq, lepi sheen derek hakkos kelal lehaddeqo kol kak bechozeq ad sheyyitchayyeb alayv mishshum boneh. Velo aseru lehaddeq apillu meat ella bemitta shel peraqim vekol kayyotze bah mishshear hakkelim, sheyyesh lachush bahem shemma yitqa bechozeq. Veyesh omerim sheen chilluq ben kos lishar kelim, veasur lehachazir hakkos, ella im ken mannicho rapuy legamre. Veyesh lehachamir kedibrehem, ella im ken bimqom tzorek gadol, azay yesh lismok lehaqel im en derek hakkos kelal lehaddeqo bechozeq. Abal kosot haasuyim bacharitzim sabib umehuddaqim bechozeq — ledibre hakkol asur lehachaziram, apillu mannicham repuyim legamre. Umikkol maqom, kissuye kelim haasuyim kak bacharitzim sabib (sheqqorin shrvy"p), ap al pi shemmehaddeqin otam bechozeq meod al pi hakkeli — en bahem shum issur, lo bintilatan mishshum setira, velo behachzaratan mishshum binyan, lepi sheenan asuyin leqiyyum kelal, raq lepotchan ulesogran tadir, gam beshabbat atzmah. Velo aseru binyan aray usetirato ella kesheeno asuy al menat lesotro beshabbat atzmah, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman shy"d:

Kol keli shel peraqim shehu mehuddaq bechozeq beinyan shehaya chayyab mishshum hidduq zeh — asur leporqo beshabbat mishshum soter. Abal im hu mehuddaq qetzat, sheen issur behidduq zeh ella mishshum gezera shemma yitqa bechozeq — en bo gam ken mishshum soter, umuttar leporqo lekattechilla:

Qora mittiqrat habbayit shennishbera — muttar lesomkah besapsal o baarukkot hammitta shehem keli, lo kede shettaaleh, shehare zeh boneh, ella kede shello tosip laredet yoter. Abal bedabar sheeno keli, ap al pi shehukan letaltel — asur lismok bo tachat haqqora, mippene sheddomeh leboneh, mah sheen ken bikli, sheen derek lebattelo lebinyan, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Vetzarik sheyyehe hakkeli rapuy qetzat tachat haqqora, beinyan sheyyukal littelo mishsham kesheyyirtzeh. Abal im mehaddeqo sham bechozeq beinyan shello yukal shub littelo mishsham — asur, mippene shemmebattel keli mehekano. Sapsal shennishmeta achat meraglayv — nitbaer besiman sh"ch:

Hammashveh pene haqqarqa babbayit o bechatzer, kegon shehishpil tel o milla guma o gay — hare zeh boneh, vechayyab. Lepikak, chatzer shennitqalqela bememe geshamim — mebi teben vezoreh bah, shehatteben eno mebattelo sham, mippene sherauy lemaakal behema o letit, ulepikak en bo mishshum binyan. Abal lo yizreh bah dabar shemmebattelo sham, mippene shennireh keillu mitkavven lehashvot pene haqqarqa, vekevan shemmebattelo sham — hare zeh binyan qabua. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bechatzer shennitqalqela, shekkevan shehu ba letaqqen hechatzer — hare zeh nireh keillu mitkavven gam ken lehashvot paneha. Abal beinyan acher — muttar lizrot bah apillu dabar shemmebattelo sham, kevan sheeno mitkavven lehashvot paneha:

Keshezzoreh hatteben bechatzer shennitqalqela — lo yizreh lo besal velo bequppa, ella beshule haqquppa, sheyyehappekennu veyabi hatteben al shuleha, kede leshannot midderek hachol. Abal asur lizrot beyado:
